records.name: BiRefNet standard DIS
strengths: Publisher weights and documented Python inference
Passed seven local benchmark categories without OOM
Sharp opaque-object edges and clean removal of the tested floor reflection
known_issues: 1.584 GiB is peak PyTorch allocated VRAM, not total board usage
Publisher Transformers loader is incompatible with installed Transformers 5.17; benchmark imports pinned local publisher source and loads safetensors directly
Default selected for opaque subjects only after one-image-per-category benchmark; Phase 6 refinement and QC remain pending

records.name: BEN2 Base
strengths: Passed seven local benchmark categories without OOM
Clean removal of the tested floor reflection
weaknesses: Enhanced commercial refiner is not included
More partly transparent pixels on opaque subjects than BiRefNet
known_issues: 2.340 GiB is peak PyTorch allocated VRAM, not total board usage
Alternative candidate only; no subject category was clearly better in this small benchmark
